items.title: Russia reports a record for the third consecutive day of 1,195 deaths from COVID-19, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 243,255.

The Netherlands reports an outbreak of the highly pathogenic H5N1 bird flu among ducks at a poultry farm in the central province of Flevoland. To reduce the spread of the virus, the Dutch government will kill 10,000 animals.
Ongoing flooding in northern Colombia kills at least 102 people.
Hurricane Michelle (2001) peaked at Category 4, 120-knot winds and 933 hPa, making landfall 4 times
M 7.1 - 146 km NW of Sola, Vanuatu
M 9.0 - 89 km ESE of Petropavlovsk-Kamchatsky, Russia
M 7.1 - 72 km W of Rumoi, Japan
M 7.0 - 40 km NE of Balkanabat, Turkmenistan
M 7.0 - 69 km ESE of Kokopo, Papua New Guinea
